raw: Shakshuka for 4. 2 cups cherry tomatoes, three cloves garlic, one bell pepper, two yellow onions, 2 cup of tomato sauce, and eight eggs. Diced onion, bell pepper, chopped garlic, sauté in olive oil till translucent seasoning with salt and pepper the onions and bell pepper add garlic while it sautéing sliced cherry tomatoes in half the long way add garlic after onions are translucent add a teaspoon of paprika and 2 pinches of cumin, add cherry tomatoes, cover, and let cook until mushy then press out all the juices add in tomato sauce mix and let simmer for 5 to 10 minutes. Crack egg into a cup use a spoon to make a divot in the sauce and pour the egg in there. Repeat until all eggs are used cover poach until egg whites are cooked and yolk is still runny about 3 minutes.  Alternatively, you can turn on the boiler and cook the eggs under there. Serve with toast and feta cheese.

components.title: Shakshuka
steps: Dice the onions and bell pepper; chop the garlic. Slice the cherry tomatoes in half the long way.
Sauté the onions and bell pepper in olive oil until translucent, seasoning with salt and pepper. Add the garlic after the onions are translucent.
Add 1 teaspoon paprika, 2 pinches cumin and the cherry tomatoes. Cover and cook until mushy, then press out all the juices.
Mix in the tomato sauce and simmer for 5 to 10 minutes.
Crack an egg into a cup. Use a spoon to make a divot in the sauce and pour in the egg. Repeat until all eggs are used.
Cover and poach for about 3 minutes, until the egg whites are cooked and the yolk is still runny. Alternatively, turn on the broiler and cook the eggs under it.
Serve with toast and feta cheese.
